$$
\text{Resolve}(B, a, p) \implies B', \quad \text{Captures}(opponent \mid \text{Liberties}=0) \to 0
$$

**Step-by-Step Implementation:**
1. Handle pass action by incrementing consecutive pass count and checking for two-pass termination.
2. Place the current player's stone at coordinate (row, col).
3. Examine adjacent opponent stone groups; if any opponent group has zero liberties, remove all its stones from the board.
4. Switch the active player turn and return updated board state.
